name: Payment Execution
definition: Process required for executing an end to end payment. It consists of a payment initiation which may be followed by a series of instructions.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the payment is a debit or a credit.

CreationDate.name: Creation Date
CreationDate.definition: Date and time at which the payment execution was created by the instructing agent.

AcceptanceDateTime.name: Acceptance Date Time
AcceptanceDateTime.definition: Date and time at which all processing conditions for execution of the payment are met and adequate financial cover is available at the account servicing agent.

RequestedExecutionDate.name: Requested Execution Date
RequestedExecutionDate.definition: Date at which the initiating party requests the clearing agent to process the payment. |Usage: This is the date on which the debtor's account is to be debited. If payment by cheque, the date when the cheque must be generated by the bank.

ExpiryDateTime.name: Expiry Date Time
ExpiryDateTime.definition: Date and time on which the payment should be expired if it has not settled.

Payment.name: Payment
Payment.definition: Specifies the end to end payment which is at the origin of the payment instruction.

ProcessingInstructions.name: Processing Instructions
ProcessingInstructions.definition: Specifies how the payment must be processed, for instance through which specific clearing channel.

RelatedInvestigationCase.name: Related Investigation Case
RelatedInvestigationCase.definition: Investigation case assigned to the payment execution.

RelatedInvestigationCaseResolution.name: Related Investigation Case Resolution
RelatedInvestigationCaseResolution.definition: Payment investigation case resolution which is the source of the corrected payment execution.

Next.name: Next
Next.definition: Specifies the next payment instruction in the payment end-to-end chain.

CurrencyExchange.name: Currency Exchange
CurrencyExchange.definition: Rate used to transform the original amount into the credited amount.

RelatedPaymentTracker.name: Related Payment Tracker
RelatedPaymentTracker.definition: Agent specific tracking system information of a payment transaction.
